proof_spans.label: the author's own proof environment immediately following the lemma: the pairwise distinct x_i are maximal ideals, so by the Chinese remainder lemma the direct sum of the fibres M(x_i) is a quotient of M, and any preimage s maps onto the prescribed values (source lines 38801-38806)
